title: SOC Analyst (L2) / Incident Responder
summary: An L2 SOC analyst handles the security alerts that first-level analysts escalate, investigating them deeply and leading the response. They sit in the SOC (security operations centre), often on shifts, between L1 analysts and the SOC lead.
dailyDuties: Investigate escalated alerts and write complex SIEM searches
Write detection rules and tune noisy alerts
Lead containment and eradication and write the incident report
Hunt for attacker techniques across logs, endpoints and network data
Enrich indicators with threat feeds and isolate hosts with EDR
Build or improve SOAR automation playbooks

skills.expectation: Write detection rules and complex searches; tune noisy alerts
Lead containment and eradication for an incident and write the report
Hunt for attacker techniques across logs, endpoints and network data
Enrich IOCs and use threat feeds to scope an attack
Collect and analyse disk or memory evidence
Run a sample in a sandbox and pull indicators
Build or improve an automation playbook
Investigate and isolate hosts with EDR
Investigate alerts in AWS, Azure or GCP logs

certifications.why: Directly tests analyst and response skills
